verdict.rationale: Object storage is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. The pack only documents managed databases, in-memory key-value storage, SSD-backed disks with snapshots, and a CDN for static assets. None of these is built-in object storage for persisting user uploads, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage
